text:
frank: opened a small PR that adds a parser-stability checklist, a micro-migration for old array envelopes, and a few SDK shim snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302

izzy: nice. quick ask: can we add one canonical example (top-level object) and a tiny legacy shim example mapping arrays -> object? keeps SDKs simple.

noor: added both in the branch. canonical example: {type: "action", payload: {...}}. legacy shim snippet in TS included.

frank: add guardrail bullets at top: prefer top-level object; one tool_call object when invoking tools; avoid anyOf at root.

noor: added bullets. also put a short troubleshooting block with a pragmatic fallback: try json.loads, then regex for first braced object. marked as best-effort.

izzy: CI flagged a stale link to /docs/old/tool-calls.md

doc-bot: link-checker: /docs/old/tool-calls.md -> 404 (line 19)

noor: fixed link to /docs/reference/tool-calling.md and pushed.

frank: include a note about argument size limits (recommend <8KB) and a tiny trimming helper in snippets.

izzy: added trimming helper and a short test prompt to reproduce typical failures.

ci-bot: PR checks queued. will report back when green.

frank: plan: merge if CI green and no objections by Friday 12:00 PT. will ping #integrations after deploy.

izzy: LGTM pending CI. noor: thanks for the quick fixes.

noor: thanks all — watching CI.
